sources.label: Danish contemporary account · Østersøes-Eskadren i 1864, pp. 4–9

note: The contemporary Danish account of the Baltic squadron describes Sjælland, Heimdal and Thor at the 17 March engagement and discusses screw revolutions and steam propulsion. A rigged steam-warship family illustrates this component. No participants are imported by this equipment patch, so the anonymous group is not a recovered order of battle.
